column2:
abnormal(adj.)異常的、不正常的
abnormality(n.)異常、反常
abnormally(adv.)異常地
abnormal behavior 異常行為
abnormal weather 異常天氣
The doctor noticed some abnormal results in his blood test.
(醫生注意到他的血液檢查中有些異常的結果。)
Scientists blame climate change for the abnormal weather this year.
(科學家將今年的異常天氣歸咎於氣候變遷。)

abolish(v.)廢除、廢止
abolition(n.)廢除
abolish a law 廢除法律
abolish slavery 廢除奴隸制度
The United States abolished slavery in 1865.
(美國於1865年廢除了奴隸制度。)
Many students hope the school will abolish the strict hair rules.
(許多學生希望學校廢除嚴格的髮禁規定。)

abortion(n.)墮胎、人工流產
abort(v.)中止、使流產
abortion law 墮胎法
legalize abortion 使墮胎合法化
The debate over abortion laws remains heated in many countries.
(在許多國家，關於墮胎法的辯論仍然十分激烈。)
Some countries have recently changed their laws on abortion.
(有些國家最近修改了有關墮胎的法律。)

abrupt(adj.)突然的、唐突的、粗魯的
abruptly(adv.)突然地
abrupt change 突然的改變
abrupt manner 唐突的態度
The meeting came to an abrupt end when the fire alarm went off.
(火災警報響起時，會議戛然而止。)
His abrupt manner made the new employees feel uncomfortable.
(他唐突的態度讓新進員工感到不自在。)

absurd(adj.)荒謬的、可笑的
absurdity(n.)荒謬
absurdly(adv.)荒謬地
absurd idea 荒謬的想法
sound absurd 聽起來很荒謬
It sounds absurd to spend so much money on a phone case.
(花那麼多錢買手機殼聽起來很荒謬。)
At first, people thought the idea of flying machines was absurd.
(起初，人們認為飛行器的構想很荒謬。)

abundant(adj.)豐富的、充足的
abundance(n.)豐富、充足
abound(v.)大量存在、充滿
abundant resources 豐富的資源
abundant rainfall 充沛的雨量
Taiwan has abundant rainfall, especially during the plum rain season.
(臺灣雨量充沛，尤其是在梅雨季期間。)
The forest provides abundant food for many kinds of wildlife.
(這片森林為許多種野生動物提供了充足的食物。)

abuse(n./v.)濫用、虐待、辱罵
abusive(adj.)虐待的、辱罵的
drug abuse 濫用藥物
abuse of power 濫用權力
The official was accused of abuse of power for personal gain.
(那名官員被指控為了私利濫用職權。)
Animal protection groups are working to stop the abuse of stray dogs.
(動物保護團體正致力於阻止虐待流浪狗的行為。)

accelerate(v.)加速、促進
acceleration(n.)加速、加速度
accelerator(n.)油門、加速器
accelerate growth 加速成長
accelerate the process 加快進程
The driver accelerated suddenly to pass the truck in front of him.
(駕駛突然加速超越前方的卡車。)
New technology has accelerated the process of globalization.
(新科技加速了全球化的進程。)

accessible(adj.)可接近的、易取得的、易懂的
access(n./v.)使用權、接近、存取
accessibility(n.)可及性、無障礙
easily accessible 容易到達的
accessible to the public 對大眾開放
The museum is easily accessible by MRT.
(搭捷運很容易就能到達這座博物館。)
The government wants to make education accessible to every child.
(政府希望讓每個孩子都能接受教育。)

accommodate(v.)容納、提供住宿、適應、通融
accommodation(n.)住宿、膳宿
accommodating(adj.)樂於助人的、隨和的
accommodate guests 容納客人
accommodate needs 滿足需求
The new hotel can accommodate up to five hundred guests.
(這家新飯店最多可容納五百位客人。)
The school tried to accommodate the needs of students with special requirements.
(學校努力滿足有特殊需求學生的需要。)

accommodation(n.)住宿、膳宿、和解
accommodate(v.)容納、提供住宿
find accommodation 找住處
student accommodation 學生宿舍
It can be difficult to find cheap accommodation in big cities.
(在大城市裡要找到便宜的住處可能很困難。)
The price of the tour includes flights and accommodation.
(旅遊團費用包含機票與住宿。)

accord(n./v.)協議、一致、給予
accordance(n.)一致、依照
accordingly(adv.)相應地、因此
of one's own accord 自願地、主動地
in accordance with 依照
He cleaned his room of his own accord without being asked.
(他沒被要求就主動打掃了自己的房間。)
The two countries signed a peace accord after years of conflict.
(兩國在多年衝突後簽署了和平協議。)

accounting(n.)會計、會計學
account(n./v.)帳戶、說明、占……
accountant(n.)會計師
accounting firm 會計師事務所
accounting department 會計部門
My sister studies accounting at university and wants to become an accountant.
(我姊姊在大學念會計，想成為一名會計師。)
Please send all receipts to the accounting department by Friday.
(請在星期五前將所有收據交給會計部門。)

acknowledge(v.)承認、致謝、確認收到、acknowledgment(n.)承認、致謝
acknowledged(adj.)公認的
acknowledge a mistake 承認錯誤
in acknowledgment of 為感謝、為表彰
He finally acknowledged that he had made a serious mistake.
(他終於承認自己犯了嚴重的錯誤。)
She received an award in acknowledgment of her years of volunteer work.
(她獲頒獎項，以表彰她多年來的志工服務。)

acquaint(v.)使熟悉、使認識
acquaintance(n.)相識的人、認識
acquainted(adj.)熟悉的、認識的
acquaint oneself with 使自己熟悉
be acquainted with 認識、熟悉
New employees need time to acquaint themselves with the company rules.
(新進員工需要時間熟悉公司規定。)
Are you acquainted with the new manager?
(你認識新來的經理嗎？)

acquisition(n.)獲得、習得、收購、購得物
acquire(v.)獲得、習得
language acquisition 語言習得
recent acquisition 新購得之物
Language acquisition is easier for young children than for adults.
(幼童學習語言比成人來得容易。)
The company announced its acquisition of a smaller tech firm.
(這家公司宣布收購一家規模較小的科技公司。)

activist(n.)社運人士、積極分子
active(adj.)積極的、活躍的
activism(n.)行動主義
environmental activist 環保人士
human rights activist 人權運動者
The young environmental activist gave a powerful speech at the conference.
(那位年輕的環保人士在會議上發表了一場震撼人心的演講。)
Activists gathered outside the building to protest the new policy.
(社運人士聚集在大樓外抗議新政策。)

acute(adj.)嚴重的、急性的、敏銳的
acutely(adv.)強烈地、敏銳地
acute pain 劇痛
acute shortage 嚴重短缺
There is an acute shortage of nurses in many hospitals.
(許多醫院面臨護理師嚴重短缺的問題。)
Dogs have an acute sense of smell.
(狗的嗅覺非常敏銳。)

administration(n.)管理、行政、政府當局
administer(v.)管理、執行、給予(藥物)
administrative(adj.)行政的、管理的
business administration 企業管理
the Biden administration 拜登政府
He decided to study business administration in college.
(他決定在大學主修企業管理。)
The new administration promised to lower taxes.
(新政府承諾要減稅。)

administrative(adj.)行政的、管理的
administration(n.)行政、管理
administrator(n.)管理者、行政人員
administrative staff 行政人員
administrative work 行政工作
Teachers often complain about having too much administrative work.
(老師們常抱怨行政工作太多。)
The administrative office is on the first floor of the main building.
(行政辦公室在主大樓的一樓。)

administrator(n.)管理者、行政人員
administer(v.)管理、執行
administration(n.)管理、行政
school administrator 學校行政人員
system administrator 系統管理員
Please contact the system administrator if you forget your password.
(如果忘記密碼，請聯絡系統管理員。)
The hospital administrator is responsible for managing the budget.
(醫院的行政主管負責管理預算。)

adolescent(adj./n.)青少年的、青少年
adolescence(n.)青春期
adolescent years 青少年時期
adolescent behavior 青少年行為
Adolescents often care a lot about what their friends think.
(青少年往往非常在意朋友的看法。)
Many changes take place in the body during adolescence.
(青春期時身體會發生許多變化。)

adore(v.)熱愛、崇拜、非常喜歡
adorable(adj.)可愛的、討人喜歡的
adoration(n.)崇拜、愛慕
adore children 非常喜愛孩子
be adored by fans 受粉絲崇拜
My little sister adores her new puppy and plays with it all day.
(我妹妹非常喜愛她的新小狗，整天都跟牠玩。)
The singer is adored by millions of fans around the world.
(這位歌手受到全世界數百萬粉絲的喜愛。)

adverse(adj.)不利的、有害的、相反的
adversity(n.)逆境、困境
adversely(adv.)不利地
adverse effects 副作用、不良影響
adverse weather conditions 惡劣天候
Some medicines may have adverse effects on your stomach.
(有些藥物可能會對你的胃產生不良影響。)
The flight was delayed due to adverse weather conditions.
(由於天候惡劣，班機延誤了。)

advocate(n./v.)提倡者、擁護者、提倡、主張
advocacy(n.)擁護、提倡
advocate for 擁護、為……發聲
strong advocate 堅定的支持者
She is a strong advocate for animal rights.
(她是動物權益的堅定擁護者。)
Many doctors advocate regular exercise as a way to reduce stress.
(許多醫生提倡規律運動作為減壓方式。)

affection(n.)喜愛、情感、感情
affectionate(adj.)充滿深情的、親切的
show affection 表達感情
deep affection 深厚的感情
The old man looked at his grandchildren with great affection.
(老人以充滿慈愛的眼神看著他的孫子們。)
Cats show affection by rubbing against your legs.
(貓會用磨蹭你的腿來表達好感。)

agenda(n.)議程、待議事項
(無詞性變化)
on the agenda 在議程上
hidden agenda 不可告人的目的
What is the first item on the agenda for today's meeting?
(今天會議議程上的第一項是什麼？)
Some people suspected that he had a hidden agenda.
(有些人懷疑他別有用心。)

aggression(n.)侵略、攻擊性行為
aggressive(adj.)侵略的、積極進取的
aggressor(n.)侵略者
act of aggression 侵略行為
signs of aggression 攻擊性的跡象
Playing violent games may lead to aggression in some children.
(玩暴力遊戲可能導致某些孩子出現攻擊行為。)
The invasion was condemned as an act of aggression.
(這次入侵被譴責為一種侵略行為。)

agony(n.)極度痛苦
agonize(v.)苦惱、煩惱
agonizing(adj.)令人痛苦的
in agony 處於極度痛苦中
agony of waiting 等待的煎熬
The injured player lay on the ground in agony.
(受傷的球員痛苦地躺在地上。)
Waiting for the exam results was pure agony for her.
(等待考試結果對她而言是一種煎熬。)

agricultural(adj.)農業的
agriculture(n.)農業
agricultural products 農產品
agricultural land 農地
Taiwan's agricultural products, such as mangoes, are popular overseas.
(臺灣的農產品，例如芒果，在海外很受歡迎。)
Much agricultural land has been turned into factories.
(許多農地已被改建成工廠。)

aisle(n.)走道、通道
(無詞性變化)
aisle seat 靠走道座位
walk down the aisle 結婚、走紅毯
I prefer an aisle seat on long flights.
(長途飛行時我偏好靠走道的座位。)
You can find the cereal in aisle five of the supermarket.
(你可以在超市的第五排走道找到穀片。)

alcoholic(adj./n.)含酒精的、酗酒者
alcohol(n.)酒精、酒
alcoholism(n.)酗酒、酒精中毒
alcoholic drinks 酒精飲料
non-alcoholic 不含酒精的
People under eighteen are not allowed to buy alcoholic drinks.
(未滿十八歲的人不得購買酒精飲料。)
The restaurant offers a wide range of non-alcoholic drinks.
(這家餐廳提供多種無酒精飲料。)

alien(adj./n.)外國的、陌生的、外星人、外國人
alienate(v.)使疏遠
alien to 與……格格不入
illegal alien 非法移民
The idea of working on weekends was completely alien to him.
(週末工作的想法對他來說完全陌生。)
Do you believe that aliens have visited the Earth?
(你相信外星人曾造訪地球嗎？)

allergic(adj.)過敏的、極討厭的
allergy(n.)過敏
be allergic to 對……過敏
allergic reaction 過敏反應
My brother is allergic to peanuts, so we never cook with them.
(我弟弟對花生過敏，所以我們從不用花生做菜。)
She had an allergic reaction after eating shrimp.
(她吃了蝦子之後出現過敏反應。)

allergy(n.)過敏症
allergic(adj.)過敏的
food allergy 食物過敏
pollen allergy 花粉過敏
Many people suffer from pollen allergies in spring.
(許多人在春天受花粉過敏所苦。)
Please tell the waiter if you have any food allergies.
(如果您有任何食物過敏，請告訴服務生。)

alliance(n.)聯盟、同盟
ally(n./v.)盟友、結盟
allied(adj.)同盟的
form an alliance 結盟
military alliance 軍事同盟
Several small companies formed an alliance to compete with the giant.
(幾家小公司結盟以對抗那家大企業。)
The two countries signed a military alliance after the war.
(兩國在戰後簽訂了軍事同盟。)

allocate(v.)分配、撥出
allocation(n.)分配、配置
allocate funds 撥款
allocate time 分配時間
The government will allocate more funds to public education.
(政府將撥出更多經費用於公共教育。)
You should allocate enough time for each subject when you study.
(讀書時你應為每一科分配足夠的時間。)

ally(n./v.)盟友、同盟國、結盟
alliance(n.)聯盟
allied(adj.)同盟的
close ally 親密盟友
ally with 與……結盟
The United States and Japan have been close allies for decades.
(美國和日本數十年來一直是親密的盟友。)
The small party decided to ally itself with a larger one.
(那個小黨決定與一個大黨結盟。)

alongside(prep./adv.)在旁邊、與……一起、並排
(無詞性變化)
work alongside 與……並肩工作
alongside each other 並排
Volunteers worked alongside firefighters to help the victims.
(志工與消防員並肩合作，協助受災者。)
The boat sailed alongside the coast for several hours.
(那艘船沿著海岸航行了好幾個小時。)

alter(v.)改變、修改
alteration(n.)改變、修改
alternative(adj./n.)替代的、替代方案
alter a plan 更改計畫
alter clothes 修改衣服
We had to alter our travel plans because of the typhoon.
(因為颱風，我們不得不更改旅行計畫。)
The tailor altered the suit so that it fit me perfectly.
(裁縫修改了這套西裝，讓它完全合我的身。)

alternate(adj./v./n.)輪流的、交替的、交替、替補者
alternately(adv.)輪流地、交替地
alternation(n.)交替、輪流
on alternate days 隔天、每隔一天
alternate between 在……之間交替
I go jogging on alternate days to give my legs a rest.
(我隔天慢跑一次，讓雙腿休息。)
Her mood alternated between hope and despair.
(她的心情在希望與絕望之間交替。)

amend(v.)修改、修正(法律等)
amendment(n.)修正案、修改
amends(n.)賠償、彌補
amend the law 修法
make amends 彌補、賠罪
Lawmakers voted to amend the traffic law last month.
(立法委員上個月投票通過修改交通法規。)
He tried to make amends for his rude behavior by buying her lunch.
(他請她吃午餐，想彌補自己無禮的行為。)

ample(adj.)充足的、寬敞的
amply(adv.)充分地
ample time 充裕的時間
ample evidence 充分的證據
There will be ample time to ask questions after the presentation.
(簡報結束後會有充裕的時間提問。)
The police found ample evidence to prove that he was guilty.
(警方找到充分的證據證明他有罪。)

analyst(n.)分析師、分析者
analyze(v.)分析
analysis(n.)分析
financial analyst 財務分析師
political analyst 政治分析家
Financial analysts expect the stock market to rise next year.
(財務分析師預期股市明年會上漲。)
She works as a data analyst for a large technology company.
(她在一家大型科技公司擔任資料分析師。)

anonymous(adj.)匿名的、無名的
anonymity(n.)匿名
anonymously(adv.)匿名地
anonymous letter 匿名信
remain anonymous 保持匿名
An anonymous donor gave one million dollars to the hospital.
(一位匿名捐贈者捐了一百萬元給醫院。)
The writer wished to remain anonymous.
(這位作者希望保持匿名。)

anticipate(v.)預期、預料、期待
anticipation(n.)預期、期待
anticipate problems 預料到問題
in anticipation of 預期、期待著
We did not anticipate so many people coming to the concert.
(我們沒預料到會有這麼多人來聽演唱會。)
The children waited in eager anticipation of the holiday.
(孩子們滿心期待地等著假期到來。)

antique(adj./n.)古董的、古董
antiquity(n.)古代、古物
antique shop 古董店
antique furniture 古董家具
My grandfather collects antique clocks from different countries.
(我爺爺收藏來自不同國家的古董時鐘。)
This antique vase is worth a fortune.
(這只古董花瓶價值不菲。)

applause(n.)鼓掌、喝采
applaud(v.)鼓掌、稱讚
warm applause 熱烈的掌聲
burst into applause 爆出掌聲
The audience burst into applause at the end of the performance.
(表演結束時，觀眾爆出熱烈掌聲。)
Let's give a big round of applause to our guest speaker.
(讓我們以熱烈的掌聲歡迎我們的演講嘉賓。)

appliance(n.)家電、器具
apply(v.)應用、申請
household appliance 家用電器
kitchen appliance 廚房電器
Remember to unplug electrical appliances before leaving on vacation.
(出門度假前記得拔掉電器的插頭。)
The store offers discounts on kitchen appliances this week.
(這家店本週廚房電器有打折。)

apt(adj.)易於……的、恰當的、聰穎的
aptly(adv.)恰當地
aptitude(n.)天資、才能
be apt to 易於、傾向於
apt description 貼切的描述
People are apt to make mistakes when they are tired.
(人在疲累時容易犯錯。)
'Busy bee' is an apt description of my mother.
(用「忙碌的蜜蜂」來形容我媽媽非常貼切。)

architect(n.)建築師、設計者
architecture(n.)建築、建築學
architectural(adj.)建築的
famous architect 知名建築師
landscape architect 景觀設計師
The architect designed the museum to look like a giant shell.
(建築師將博物館設計成巨大貝殼的模樣。)
He was the chief architect of the new peace plan.
(他是這項新和平計畫的主要策劃者。)

architecture(n.)建築、建築學、建築風格
architect(n.)建築師
architectural(adj.)建築的
modern architecture 現代建築
study architecture 學建築
Taipei 101 is a famous example of modern architecture.
(臺北101是現代建築的知名範例。)
She went to Italy to study classical architecture.
(她去義大利研讀古典建築。)

arena(n.)競技場、舞臺、活動領域
(無詞性變化)
sports arena 體育館
political arena 政治舞臺
The concert will be held at the city's largest sports arena.
(演唱會將在城市最大的體育館舉行。)
She entered the political arena at a young age.
(她年紀輕輕就踏入了政壇。)

arouse(v.)喚起、激起
arousal(n.)喚起、激發
arouse interest 引起興趣
arouse suspicion 引起懷疑
The strange noise aroused the curiosity of the children.
(那奇怪的聲音激起了孩子們的好奇心。)
His nervous behavior aroused the suspicion of the police.
(他緊張的舉動引起了警方的懷疑。)

array(n.)一系列、大量、陳列
(無詞性變化)
a wide array of 各式各樣的
an array of 一系列的
The night market offers a wide array of local snacks.
(夜市提供各式各樣的在地小吃。)
The museum displays an impressive array of ancient art.
(博物館陳列著一系列令人驚嘆的古代藝術品。)

arrogant(adj.)傲慢的、自大的
arrogance(n.)傲慢
arrogantly(adv.)傲慢地
arrogant attitude 傲慢的態度
arrogant behavior 自大的行為
His arrogant attitude made it hard for him to make friends.
(他傲慢的態度讓他很難交到朋友。)
It is arrogant to think you are always right.
(認為自己永遠是對的是一種傲慢。)

articulate(v./adj.)清楚表達、口齒清晰的、善於表達的
articulation(n.)清楚表達、發音
articulate ideas 清楚表達想法
articulate speaker 能言善道的講者
She was able to articulate her ideas clearly in the debate.
(她在辯論中能清楚表達自己的想法。)
He is an articulate young man with a bright future.
(他是個能言善道、前途光明的年輕人。)

ass(n.)驢子、笨蛋
(無詞性變化)
make an ass of oneself 出洋相
stubborn as an ass 像驢子一樣固執
He made an ass of himself by singing loudly in the library.
(他在圖書館大聲唱歌，讓自己出盡洋相。)
In the old story, the farmer rode an ass to the market.
(在那則古老故事中，農夫騎著驢子去市場。)

assault(n./v.)攻擊、襲擊、突擊
assailant(n.)攻擊者
physical assault 人身攻擊
launch an assault 發動攻擊
The man was arrested for assault after the fight in the bar.
(那名男子在酒吧打架後因傷害罪被捕。)
The army launched an assault on the enemy's base at dawn.
(軍隊在黎明時對敵軍基地發動突擊。)

assert(v.)斷言、主張、維護(權利)
assertion(n.)斷言、主張
assertive(adj.)堅定自信的、果斷的
assert oneself 堅持己見、表現自己
assert one's rights 維護權利
The suspect continued to assert that he was innocent.
(嫌疑人持續堅稱自己是無辜的。)
You need to learn to assert yourself in group discussions.
(你需要學會在小組討論中表達自己的立場。)

assess(v.)評估、評定、assessment(n.)評估、評價
assessor(n.)評估者
assess the damage 評估損害
risk assessment 風險評估
Experts were sent to assess the damage caused by the earthquake.
(專家被派去評估地震造成的損害。)
Teachers use different kinds of assessment to check students' progress.
(老師使用各種評量方式來檢視學生的進步。)

asset(n.)資產、有價值的人或物
(無詞性變化)
valuable asset 寶貴的資產
assets and liabilities 資產與負債
Her language skills are a valuable asset to the company.
(她的語言能力是公司的寶貴資產。)
The family sold some of their assets to pay off the debt.
(這家人變賣了部分資產來償還債務。)

assumption(n.)假設、假定、承擔
assume(v.)假設、認為、承擔
make an assumption 做出假設
on the assumption that 假定……
It is dangerous to make assumptions about people based on their looks.
(根據外表對人做出假設是很危險的。)
We planned the event on the assumption that it wouldn't rain.
(我們是在假定不會下雨的前提下規劃這個活動。)

astonish(v.)使驚訝、astonishment(n.)驚訝
astonishing(adj.)令人驚訝的
astonished(adj.)感到驚訝的
to one's astonishment 令某人驚訝的是
be astonished at 對……感到驚訝
The young pianist astonished the audience with her amazing skills.
(那位年輕鋼琴家以驚人的技巧讓觀眾大為驚豔。)
To my astonishment, the shy boy won the speech contest.
(令我驚訝的是，那個害羞的男孩贏得了演講比賽。)

athletics(n.)田徑運動、體育運動
athlete(n.)運動員
athletic(adj.)運動的、強健的
athletics team 田徑隊
athletics meet 田徑運動會
She joined the school athletics team and trained every morning.
(她加入學校田徑隊，每天早上都去訓練。)
The national athletics meet attracts many talented young runners.
(全國田徑運動會吸引了許多有天分的年輕跑者。)

attendance(n.)出席、出席人數
attend(v.)出席、參加
attendant(n.)服務員
take attendance 點名
perfect attendance 全勤
The teacher takes attendance at the beginning of every class.
(老師在每堂課開始時都會點名。)
She received an award for perfect attendance this semester.
(她這學期因全勤而獲獎。)

attic(n.)閣樓
(無詞性變化)
in the attic 在閣樓裡
attic room 閣樓房間
We found a box of old family photos in the attic.
(我們在閣樓裡找到一箱老舊的家族照片。)
He turned the attic into a small study room.
(他把閣樓改造成一間小書房。)

attorney(n.)律師、代理人
(無詞性變化)
defense attorney 辯護律師
attorney general 檢察總長、司法部長
The defense attorney argued that her client was innocent.
(辯護律師主張她的當事人是無辜的。)
You should talk to an attorney before signing the contract.
(在簽約之前，你應該先諮詢律師。)

attribute(v.)把……歸因於、認為……是某人所作
attribution(n.)歸因、歸屬
attribute A to B 把A歸因於B
be attributed to 被認為是……所作
She attributes her success to hard work and good luck.
(她將自己的成功歸因於努力和好運。)
This famous poem is attributed to Li Bai.
(這首著名的詩被認為是李白所作。)

auction(n./v.)拍賣、拍賣會、拍賣掉
auctioneer(n.)拍賣師
at auction 在拍賣會上
online auction 網路拍賣
The famous painting was sold at auction for ten million dollars.
(那幅名畫在拍賣會上以一千萬元售出。)
They decided to auction off the old furniture.
(他們決定把那批舊家具拍賣掉。)

authorize(v.)授權、批准
authority(n.)權威、當局
authorization(n.)授權、許可
authorized(adj.)經授權的
authorize payment 批准付款
authorized dealer 授權經銷商
Only the manager can authorize refunds over one thousand dollars.
(只有經理能批准超過一千元的退款。)
You should buy the phone from an authorized dealer.
(你應該向授權經銷商購買手機。)

autonomy(n.)自治、自主權
autonomous(adj.)自治的、自主的
personal autonomy 個人自主
regional autonomy 地區自治
Teenagers often want more autonomy in making their own decisions.
(青少年常常希望在做決定時擁有更多自主權。)
The region was granted a high degree of autonomy.
(該地區被賦予了高度自治權。)

awe(n./v.)敬畏、驚嘆、使敬畏
awesome(adj.)令人驚嘆的、很棒的
awful(adj.)可怕的、糟糕的
in awe of 對……敬畏
stand in awe 肅然起敬
We stood in awe as we watched the sunrise from the top of Jade Mountain.
(我們在玉山頂上看日出時心生敬畏。)
The young players were in awe of the famous coach.
(年輕球員們對那位知名教練心懷敬畏。)
